name: Salifert Nitrate Profi-Test
description: Reagent nitrate kit with a low and a medium range. Published ranges: low 0.2–10 mg/L NO3, medium 2–100 mg/L NO3. Modelled here as a single 0.2–100 ppm reading spanning both scales (the kit picks the scale by dilution). Free of amine interference; ~60 tests per kit.
notes: The kit ships two range cards (0.2–10 and 2–100); the entry spans both. The freshwater and marine versions differ only in the colour card.
